alignment_status: Scoped vocabulary alignment and field navigation; no RDF entailment, reasoner, validation against every standard or claim of full compliance.

lenses.title: PROV-O · provenance
lenses.scope: Follow a retained record to its named provider release, original identifier, source locator and byte identity.

templates.subject: record
templates.scope: The normalized record derives from the named source dataset, not an independent corroborating source.

limitations: Lineage is not verification or source independence.
No claim is made that every upstream news reference was retrieved or reviewed.

lenses.title: SKOS · concepts
lenses.scope: Keep provider category codes and their labels explicit. GED violence types are concepts in a small source-specific scheme; annual series retain their own indicator identifiers.

templates.subject: record
templates.scope: A category explicitly supplied by the provider. No inferred topic, allegiance or cross-scheme equivalence.

limitations: No skos:exactMatch or broader/narrower hierarchy is inferred.
Provider classification does not establish a present-day affiliation or a political judgment.

lenses.title: OWL-Time · time
lenses.scope: Inspect the provider event date window and its precision; distinguish an annual series label from an exact observation instant.

templates.subject: reported_interval
templates.scope: A source-qualified date boundary, not proof of an exact instant.

templates.subject: reported_interval
templates.scope: The full reported date window remains visible.

limitations: No Allen interval reasoning or ordering inference is run.
Raw midnight timestamps are not treated as precise times; annual values may refer to fiscal or modelled periods described by series metadata.

lenses.title: GeoSPARQL · geography
lenses.scope: Separate a reported feature from its provider coordinate representation and geographic precision. A marker can represent a broad area.

templates.subject: reported_feature
templates.scope: Coordinate representation only; not current control, a precise impact location or a boundary decision.

limitations: No SPARQL geometry engine, spatial topology reasoning or GeoSPARQL conformance suite is implemented.
Annual economy values are not geocoded as conflict events; provider country labels are retained without sovereignty inference.

lenses.title: SOSA / SSN · observations
lenses.standard_version: W3C / OGC Semantic Sensor Network Ontology, 2017
lenses.scope: Use the SOSA observation/property/feature/result pattern to inspect an actual World Bank annual value. The source may be estimated or modelled; this does not assert a physical sensor or a direct measurement.

templates.subject: provider_annual_observation
templates.scope: The named annual indicator; not an inferred conflict metric.

templates.subject: provider_annual_observation
templates.scope: The source economy classification, not an event point.

templates.subject: provider_annual_observation
templates.scope: Preserve value, metadata-derived display unit and raw unit separately.

templates.subject: provider_annual_observation
templates.scope: An annual reference label, not a known measurement instant or retrieval time.

limitations: The concrete example is a provider annual population result, not a GED conflict record or sensor observation.
No madeBySensor, instrument, procedure, exact measurement time or SSN implementation/compliance is invented.
An annual value aligned with an event year is not evidence of causation.
